`pothole-public-domain.jpg` is the unmodified photograph **Pothole Big.jpg** by
Wikimedia Commons contributor **Uncl3dad**, originally dated16November2005.

- [Original file and author/license record](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pothole_Big.jpg)
- [File](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/c7/Pothole_Big.jpg)
- The author released the image into the public domain worldwide (PD-self).

This image is used only for an explicit inference smoke test. Its geographic
location and surveyed defect dimensions are not known to this project. It must not
be attached to an operational road as evidence of a hazard there. It has no curated
ground-truth masks or metrology annotations and cannot establish model accuracy.
